name: Radix carry threshold
source_expression: Digit-count changes at powers of the radix.
normalized_operator: Use radix powers as scale/change boundaries and compact level indices.
notes: Exact for positional number systems.

name: Zero-based offset semantics
source_expression: An index of 35 denotes the 36th stored position.
normalized_operator: Keep value, offset and ordinal position as distinct typed quantities.
notes: Prevents off-by-one errors; not altered arithmetic.

name: Active-bit/Hamming-weight filter
source_expression: 19 = 10011 has three active bits; zeros are treated as inactive.
normalized_operator: Use popcount as a sparse feature count or seed descriptor.
notes: The phonetic syllable link is a mnemonic, not a general encoding law.

name: Three-point triangle seed
source_expression: Three active positions are treated as triangle anchors.
normalized_operator: Map three non-collinear active samples to a simplex/triangle primitive.
notes: Any three non-collinear points form a triangle; the mapping is chosen.

name: Pascal parity to Sierpinski
source_expression: Odd/even entries in Pascal triangle form a Sierpinski pattern.
normalized_operator: Use binomial parity as a deterministic fractal/test-pattern generator.
notes: Technical correction: rows 2^k-1, not generally 2^k, are all odd when indexed from zero.

name: Golden-angle/Fibonacci sampling
source_expression: Phi/Vogel spacing is proposed to avoid visible repetition.
normalized_operator: Optional quasi-uniform angular sample schedule or dither seed.
notes: Useful heuristic; it does not guarantee zero aliasing or zero cost.

name: Lemniscate/strange-loop recursion
source_expression: Infinity and Escher loops symbolize self-generation.
normalized_operator: Represent recursion with explicit finite grammar depth and cycle detection.
notes: Keep as a recursion motif, not a proof of self-creating physics.

name: Loop-plus-stem decomposition
source_expression: Chosen phi/D/B glyphs are decomposed into loop(s) plus a stem.
normalized_operator: Represent glyph geometry as a graph of curve segments and junctions.
notes: Glyph form varies by font; the decomposition is a design convention.

name: Cut-unroll D/B to R
source_expression: Break the lower loop and straighten the released arc into a diagonal leg.
normalized_operator: Boundary-graph edit plus continuous curve morph from closed arc to open segment.
notes: Implementable as path topology and control-point interpolation.

name: Torque axis T
source_expression: The stem is an axis; rotation shears/unreels the lower loop.
normalized_operator: Use a rotation/warp parameter around a declared pivot axis.
notes: Torque language is a kinematic metaphor unless a physical model is supplied.

name: Delta-time and phase modulation
source_expression: Delta T and delta phi drive movement and phase change.
normalized_operator: Store continuous time and phase as separate state coordinates and derivatives.
notes: Do not overload time, torque and triangle into one untyped symbol.

name: One-bit parity hinge
source_expression: A bit toggles closed/open or route A/B.
normalized_operator: Use a schema-bound route/parity flag that selects transition behavior.
notes: The bit is not the complete state.

name: Global hinge field
source_expression: The hinge is applied everywhere through an SDF sign/state change.
normalized_operator: Model a global morph or transition field evaluated at every query point.
notes: A morph parameter changes the implicit field; topology changes require explicit handling.

name: Chirality/orientation flip
source_expression: R/S or mirrored states are associated with sign/orientation reversal.
normalized_operator: Track an orientation bit and apply a gluing/transition map that may flip it.
notes: Orientation is distinct from sheet and phase.

name: Split oval to opposing arches
source_expression: A zero-centered oval is split and torque opens it into positive/negative wave arches.
normalized_operator: Use symmetric curve branches around a fixed node for waveform or deformation profiles.
notes: The exact 1:1 amplitude condition is a chosen symmetric case, not universal warped-disk physics.

name: Overlap lens/shared domain
source_expression: Slightly overlapping semicircles form an interference/tolerance/shared-information zone.
normalized_operator: Use intersection A∩B, lens area, or blend region as explicit shared domain.
notes: Interpretation depends on geometry, mechanics or information semantics.

name: Signed distance/implicit field
source_expression: Geometry is represented by f(p), with f=0 as the boundary.
normalized_operator: Use implicit scalar fields; reserve exact-distance claims for valid primitives/transforms.
notes: A generic implicit field need not be an exact SDF.

name: SDF CSG operators
source_expression: Union=min, intersection=max, subtraction=max(a,-b).
normalized_operator: Provide composable implicit-field operators with documented sign convention.
notes: Smooth variants may be added as optional adapters.

name: Zero surface as event relation
source_expression: The SDF-zero locus becomes a transition surface, not a place to march through.
normalized_operator: Treat R_j(q)=0 as an event guard and solve crossing time.
notes: This is the central correction from rendering to event semantics.

name: Analytic kinematic sweep
source_expression: A cone/trajectory is solved against an implicit boundary for exact event time.
normalized_operator: Use closed-form roots for restricted trajectory/surface pairs; certified numerical roots otherwise.
notes: No universal non-iterative solver exists.

name: Cone as support/domain
source_expression: Cones are directional influence, field-of-view or admissibility domains.
normalized_operator: Use analytic radial-angular support predicates for pruning/query scope.
notes: Not necessarily a rendered cone.

name: Spherical/local radial-angular support
source_expression: Spherical means a local chart around a sensor/coupler, not a global world remesh.
normalized_operator: Represent local support by radius, angle, orientation, uncertainty and time window.
notes: Core type-safety rule.

name: Nested shells
source_expression: Shells organize radial reach, scale and relevance.
normalized_operator: Use concentric support bands or multiresolution radial intervals.
notes: Useful local indexing structure, not required globally.

name: Hourglass/quad routing
source_expression: Four conical chambers meet at a pinch/event locus.
normalized_operator: Implement a finite routing partition keyed by sign/sheet/orientation at a transition surface.
notes: The pinch is an event/router, not a literal singularity that destroys data.

name: Invariant/eigen-axis
source_expression: A central axis or mode persists through transformations.
normalized_operator: Declare invariants and preserved quantities for transitions.
notes: Eigenlanguage is only literal when a linear operator is actually defined.

name: Projective/homogeneous chart
source_expression: Null-cone and projective language compactifies direction/scale.
normalized_operator: Optional homogeneous coordinates for intersections and points at infinity.
notes: Use only where it improves equations and conditioning.

name: Log-polar transform
source_expression: rho=ln(r), theta=atan2(y,x).
normalized_operator: Use a local coordinate chart that turns radial scaling into translation in rho.
notes: Handle r=0 with an epsilon/core cell.

name: One-bit log-polar LUT
source_expression: A bitmask activates radial-angular sectors.
normalized_operator: Use as a coarse admission/cache mask, never as the whole world state.
notes: Schema and quantization parameters are mandatory.

name: Phasor/Feynman-style edge accumulation
source_expression: Subpixel samples carry magnitude/phase and are accumulated.
normalized_operator: Normalize to complex phasor or oriented coverage accumulation for antialiasing.
notes: Not a literal Feynman path integral unless a physical path-integral model is defined.

name: One-bit stochastic jitter
source_expression: Binary noise shifts samples/thresholds around an edge.
normalized_operator: Use deterministic blue-noise/hash dithering with reproducible seeds.
notes: Jitter trades structured error for noise; it does not remove error.

name: Temporal pulse-density modulation
source_expression: Brightness/coverage is encoded as density of one-bit pulses.
normalized_operator: Optional display-output adapter using PDM or delta-sigma modulation.
notes: Panel hardware and refresh limits remain.

name: Chromatic log-radius offset
source_expression: Channel scaling becomes additive rho offsets.
normalized_operator: Apply channel-specific log-radius shifts before field evaluation, then resample correctly.
notes: Cheap coordinate arithmetic is not zero-cost end-to-end correction.

name: Log-polar prepress screening
source_expression: Spatial one-bit dots scale with rho and orient with theta.
normalized_operator: Optional print adapter with calibrated halftone, screen angles and dot-gain compensation.
notes: Requires press/paper calibration.

name: Phase sheets
source_expression: Multiple states occupy layered sheets over the same base coordinate.
normalized_operator: Represent state as base position plus sheet, phase, orientation and address.
notes: Layer identity must be explicit.

name: Double vacuum
source_expression: Co-located states do not interact when phase/sheet/address are incompatible.
normalized_operator: Compatibility-gated coupling: same x does not imply same sector.
notes: One of the strongest corpus concepts.

name: Mobius gluing
source_expression: A boundary identification reverses orientation after one loop.
normalized_operator: Implement quotient-map boundary wrapping with orientation flip.
notes: Use a chart/gluing abstraction rather than literal 4D geometry.

name: Klein-bottle gluing
source_expression: A closed non-orientable quotient is used for looping routes.
normalized_operator: Implement two rectangle-edge identifications, one orientation reversing.
notes: Hardware realization remains frontier; 3D pictures self-intersect.

name: Topological portal/gluing map
source_expression: Crossing a boundary re-enters another chart/sheet, possibly transformed.
normalized_operator: Use explicit port, orientation map, coordinate transform and transfer metadata.
notes: This makes topology technically testable.

name: Inside/outside sign with schema
source_expression: Binary sign denotes interior/exterior or route state.
normalized_operator: Bind every bit to a declared schema/version and keep uncertainty separate.
notes: Raw bits without layout/schema are ambiguous.

name: Strange loop/self-reference
source_expression: Escher/Klein motifs suggest systems feeding back into themselves.
normalized_operator: Use explicit cycles, fixed points and termination/cycle policies in the grammar/event graph.
notes: Narrative inspiration only unless formally specified.

name: Finite grammar G
source_expression: A finite rule set generates relations/structures.
normalized_operator: Use bounded-depth typed productions that compile to supported relation primitives.
notes: Enforce symbol and expression caps.

name: State manifold Q
source_expression: State includes position, time, phase, sheet, address and branch.
normalized_operator: Use a typed immutable state record; optional orientation and uncertainty extensions.
notes: Core data model.

name: Relation family R_j(q)=0
source_expression: World geometry/constraints are equations rather than frame snapshots.
normalized_operator: Store typed relations with parameters, domains and solver capability metadata.
notes: Restrict to relation families with known solvers for the prototype.

name: Support predicate C<=0
source_expression: Only relations inside a declared local support are candidates.
normalized_operator: Separate admission/support from geometry and from compatibility.
notes: Supports analytic pruning.

name: Compatibility predicate chi
source_expression: Co-location is insufficient; phase/sheet/mode/time/policy must match.
normalized_operator: Compose physical and digital compatibility predicates.
notes: Return reason codes, not only a bit.

name: Event time t*
source_expression: The next event is the earliest supported compatible relation root.
normalized_operator: Compute min valid root after t0 with tolerance and confidence.
notes: Multiple roots and tangencies need policy.

name: Transition rule T_j
source_expression: Crossing an event surface updates sheet/phase/branch/invariants.
normalized_operator: Use pure transition functions producing state patches and event records.
notes: Preserve pre/post states and provenance.

name: Lineage address
source_expression: Identity persists by generative address and invariant history.
normalized_operator: Use stable entity IDs plus parent/merge ancestry and transition lineage.
notes: Coordinates are not identity.

name: Irreducible external event log
source_expression: Novel exogenous events must be recorded even when closed dynamics are recomputable.
normalized_operator: Event-source only novelty, transitions, confidence and calibration changes.
notes: No zero-memory claim.

name: Query-first API
source_expression: Ask state_at(t), next_event, events_in_support, coupling and identity.
normalized_operator: Expose direct query methods independent of a frame loop.
notes: Projection is downstream.

name: Projection adapter
source_expression: Images are optional outputs, not the authoritative state.
normalized_operator: Place raster/raymarch/SDF preview in a replaceable adapter layer.
notes: Do not mistake the projector for the state space.

name: Hybrid layer separation
source_expression: Persistent world state, local sensing and display remain distinct.
normalized_operator: Use core/query/projection/hardware modules with explicit interfaces.
notes: Avoid polar-everything and raster-everything.

name: Branch and chamber routing
source_expression: Events route state through branches/sheets/chambers.
normalized_operator: Use finite enums and explicit routing tables.
notes: Avoid implicit magic routing.

name: Uncertainty/confidence
source_expression: Verified outputs include error, confidence and calibration.
normalized_operator: Attach numeric intervals/confidence and solver status to every event.
notes: Essential for real systems.

name: Schema-bound packed data caution
source_expression: Raw packed bits are meaningless without layout metadata.
normalized_operator: Version all bitfields/LUTs and ship schema with data.
notes: Useful contrast from the COBOL sections.

name: Agent on shared relation substrate
source_expression: Perception/action can issue the same support/event queries.
normalized_operator: Keep agent integration minimal: queries and transition choices, not universal AI compression.
notes: Do not claim an LLM is replaced by the geometry.

name: Analytic motion component
source_expression: Position/velocity/acceleration are closed-form trajectories.
normalized_operator: Entity component stores trajectory coefficients and state patches.
notes: Supports horizon skipping for fixed formulas.

name: Continuous collision/event component
source_expression: Collisions are relation roots under support/compatibility.
normalized_operator: Event solver returns ordered crossings with guard semantics.
notes: Fallback numerical solver is allowed.

name: Sensor cone component
source_expression: Agent/sensor relevance uses local radial-angular supports.
normalized_operator: FOV/range query before relation solving.
notes: Useful in Unity/Godot/ECS adapters.

name: Procedural grammar component
source_expression: L-system/shape grammar generates bounded relation sets.
normalized_operator: Compile grammar tokens to primitives, supports and transitions.
notes: Finite depth and normalization required.

name: Topological portal component
source_expression: Mobius/Klein/hourglass routes connect spaces with orientation/sheet changes.
normalized_operator: Portal has entry surface, exit transform, sheet map and lineage event.
notes: Can be rendered conventionally while simulated symbolically.

name: Deterministic network/event replication
source_expression: Seed plus event log reconstructs closed dynamics.
normalized_operator: Replicate authoritative events and schema versions, not every visual frame.
notes: Only works where deterministic formulas are stable across platforms.

name: Graphics preview component
source_expression: SDF/log-polar/jitter projects core state to pixels.
normalized_operator: Optional GPU or CPU preview; no authority over simulation.
notes: Provides practical game-engine visualization.

name: Bounded Compatibility Event (B.C.E.)
source_expression: A verified event is declared only after support, compatibility and a measured guard crossing.
normalized_operator: Reuse the core event schema for a measured optofluidic front end.
notes: The best-defined physical endpoint in the corpus.

name: Local support -> liquid lens -> mode -> guard
source_expression: Radial-angular input is tuned, coupled, interfered and thresholded.
normalized_operator: Separate optical, fluid, mode and digital-control models.
notes: Maxwell, Young-Laplace/coupled-mode theory and control logic stay type-separated.

name: Matrix-in-glass
source_expression: A waveguide mesh implements a calibrated transfer function.
normalized_operator: Treat as a measured passive/tunable transfer matrix, not stored imagery.
notes: Requires calibration and drift tracking.

name: One-bit hardware route flag
source_expression: Parity denotes admission/route/freshness, not amplitude.
normalized_operator: Store amplitudes, thresholds, uncertainty and lineage separately.
notes: Same type-safety rule as software.

name: Spherical throughput metric
source_expression: Count verified events/queries per second at a declared error budget.
normalized_operator: Report support, compatibility, miss/false rates, energy, latency and drift.
notes: Not photon flux alone.

name: Hollowlens-0 demonstrator
source_expression: Scanned input, tunable liquid coupler, 2x2 interferometer, balanced detectors, digital sidecar.
normalized_operator: Prototype only after guard, compatibility, calibration and baseline are preregistered.
notes: Can fail usefully.
